question: Why is haloperidol short, and what do we do?

steps.title: Our stock in three hospitals
steps.purpose: Read on-hand stock and 28-day use where each hospital keeps it.
steps.finding: 6 stock lines across 3 hospitals, 3 presentations, in units of use.

steps.finding: Not on FDA's current shortage list.

steps.title: Who else makes it

steps.finding: 19 labelers make it in this form.

steps.title: What FDA found at those plants
steps.purpose: Read every FDA drug inspection, warning letter, import alert and recall for these plants.
steps.finding: 10 inspections (3 OAI at our plants), 3 compliance actions, 0 import-alert listings, 5 recalls.

steps.title: What FDA wrote at the OAI inspections
steps.purpose: Read the Form 483 observations recorded at those inspections.

steps.title: What our P&T committee already approved
steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.title: Which links can't be trusted
steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's key rules (NDC and unit of use) over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 11 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 0 of them are this drug. Every row is in a shared unit of use.

steps.title: What we decided last time
steps.purpose: Recall past decisions on this drug from H-MEM, with who approved them.
steps.finding: No past decisions on this drug.

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows haloperidol lactate is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 40 vials of the 5 mg/mL 1 mL presentation at 7.6 vials per day, giving 5.3 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 140 vials of the same presentation at 7.8 vials per day, giving 17.9 days on hand.
The rule‑ranked option 1 is to transfer 30 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East; after transfer Corvale General would retain 14 days and Corvale East would reach 9 days.
A separate FDA shortage entry shows Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC plans to discontinue haloperidol decanoate injection (not the lactate formulation) with an initial posting date of 2026-01-09.
No FDA inspection or enforcement action is recorded for the Fresenius Kabi USA plant linked to this NDC in the provided evidence.
